TRIALS = [
    (1, 0.71),
    (2, 0.78),
    (3, 0.83),
    (4, 0.82),
    (5, 0.80),
    (6, 0.84),
]
PATIENCE = 2

def run_study(trials, patience):
    best_acc = float('-inf')
    best_trial = None
    no_improve = 0
    last_trial = None
    for n, acc in trials:
        last_trial = n
        if acc > best_acc:
            best_acc = acc
            best_trial = n
            no_improve = 0
            print(f'trial {n}: acc={acc:.2f} (new best)')
        else:
            no_improve += 1
            print(f'trial {n}: acc={acc:.2f}')
        if no_improve == patience:
            print(f'early stopping triggered after trial {n}')
            break
    print(f'best: trial {best_trial} with acc={best_acc:.2f}')
    return best_trial, best_acc, last_trial

run_study(TRIALS, PATIENCE)
